decision: Use a protocol-led synthesis with publication-to-study identity resolution and outcome-class boundaries.
credible_alternatives: Narrative reading of convenient papers; rejected because it cannot support a traceable corpus or study-level claim.
criteria: Route fit; evidence production; feasibility; authority; reversibility
evidence_and_authority: Protocol-defined eligibility, duplicate and companion-publication resolution, appraisal and synthesis by feedback mechanism and outcome class.
assumptions_and_risks: Synthetic corpus, illustrative searches, study heterogeneity, publication-to-study resolution and no quantitative pooling.
conditional_commitment: Use a protocol-led synthesis with publication-to-study identity resolution and outcome-class boundaries.
early_test: Run one database query, resolve a duplicate publication cluster and test the extraction form before the full search.
reopening_trigger: Failed early evidence reopens Design Gate; unavailable or unauthorised evidence reopens Problem or Evidence Gate.
